ItemID: unavailable; Title: Don Henley Cass County; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The roots-oriented sound interests me, but I would sample it another time.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Croz; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Reflective songwriting fits my mood, though it is not my first pick today.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: The Wild Feathers; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Roots rock sounds promising, but I am not interested enough to explore a less familiar act today.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Houses of the Holy 2014; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am more interested in relaxed blues and roots music than heavier rock right now.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Wings Over America; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: A lengthy live album is not what I want for this listening session.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Physical Graffiti; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Its heavier sound does not match my current interest in laid-back, song-focused music.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Live at the Academy of Music 1971; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The Band's roots sound appeals to me, but I would pass on a live collection today.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: The Breeze: An Appreciation of JJ Cale; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: Having recently listened to Old Sock, I would choose this for its connection to Clapton and relaxed blues sound.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Standing in the Breach; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The singer-songwriter direction fits my interest in You Should Be So Lucky, but I would save it for later.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: The Endless River; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Atmospheric instrumental music is less appealing than vocals and roots-oriented songs right now.
